messages:
Theo: Found a tiny rubber penguin on the conference-room shelf. Who does it belong to? Also proposing we name it.
Rina: The penguin is obviously "Penguino". Strong, noble, slightly soggy.
Omar: I call dibs on "Captain Waddle". He looks like a captain.
Jules: Can we have a lore origin? Maybe it was the mascot for the sprint that survived three rollbacks.
Theo: MailBot: FYI small desk trinkets without labels will be considered community property after 7 days.
MailBot: Noted. Please label personal items to avoid communal adoption.
Rina: If it's community property, I volunteer to be the first Penguin Custodian. Duties: moving penguin to strategic locations for morale boosts.
Omar: Responsibilities accepted. Also suggest we give the penguin a tiny hat. I can 3D-print a micro-top-hat.
Jules: Tiny top hat + tiny cape = instant mythology. Also propose a one-line backstory: "Sentinel of standups, watcher of snack raids."
Theo: PeopleOps: can we get a small emoji for the penguin? :penguino: would be useful for reactions to acceptable levels of silliness.
PeopleOps: Emoji requests go through design, but small fun emojis are usually OK. Submit a 32px asset and we'll review.
Rina: I'll sketch a bad pixel art penguin tonight. Low-res charm.
Omar: Rule suggestion: Penguin Custodian rotates weekly. Custodian may place penguin in a colleague's desk for anonymous compliments.
Jules: I love the anonymous compliment delivery system. That will fix 3pm slumps.
Theo: MailBot: received compliment policy note. Please avoid passive-aggressive notes.
MailBot: Reminder: anonymous notes should be kind and constructive. Harassment not permitted.
Rina: First penguin mission: hide in the snack cupboard at 10:00 and confuse the breakfast team.
Omar: I will make the hat. Rina will create pixel emoji. Jules will write a five-sentence heroic origin story. Theo will pretend this was always planned.
PeopleOps: If the tradition sustains, we'll add a one-line entry to the culture guide and order a small plush. Fun, low-cost traditions welcome.
Jules: Origin draft: "In a time of flaky builds and brave PRs, a rubber penguin watched over the team. It waddled into standups, blessed the snacks, and inspired two heroic merge rescues. Thus, the penguin earned its cape."
Rina: Official vote: penguin name = Penguino. Reactions count.
Theo: +1. Long live Penguino.
Omar: +1 for Captain Waddle in spirit.
MailBot: Item adoption complete: Penguino now community property. Please be kind to him.
Jules: Photo op tomorrow 09:30. Bring tiny hat prototypes.
Rina: I'll deliver emoji asset by EOD.
PeopleOps: Thanks everyone. Small traditions like this add a lot. We'll coordinate if penguin merch becomes a thing.
Theo: Closing note: whoever steals Penguino will be required to perform a haiku at the next retro.
Omar: Threat accepted.
